cases.question: 请用表格比较 2026 年 Atlas gateway 在 production 和 staging 的超时及 Redis 请求正文写入权限。没有声明的值请说明。

cases.question: Which component receives API Gateway traffic, and where is that component deployed? Distinguish explicit facts from missing information.
cases.reference_answer: API Gateway routes to Mercury worker. Only Mercury production service is explicitly located in Beijing; the worker location is not separately established.

required_facts.text: API Gateway routes traffic to Mercury worker.
